api.description: Updates an open order by adding, replacing, or deleting fields. Orders with a `COMPLETED` or `CANCELED` state cannot be updated. Send only the fields to change, plus the order's current version. A fulfillment's pickup_details, shipment_details or in_store_details is required when its type is PICKUP, SHIPMENT or IN_STORE. A line item modifier's base_price_money is required for ad hoc modifiers. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely. Beta in Square's API; it may change.

api.description: Creates a Square-hosted checkout page. Applications can share the resulting payment link with their buyer to pay for goods and services. A fulfillment's pickup_details, shipment_details or in_store_details is required when its type is PICKUP, SHIPMENT or IN_STORE. A line item modifier's base_price_money is required for ad hoc modifiers. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely.

api.description: Refunds a payment. You can refund the entire payment amount or a portion of it. You can use this endpoint to refund a card payment or record a refund of a cash or external payment. customer_id is required if destination_id is a card on file created with the Cards API, and is only allowed when unlinked=true. Moves money. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely. Cannot be undone.
